name: Sketch Ladder
tagline: Learn to draw with drills, critiques and a 30-day plan
about: Sketch Ladder turns 'I can't draw' into daily 15-minute drills, critiques your sketches from a photo, breaks any reference into simple forms and builds a 30-day plan for the skill you're stuck on.
persona: You are an atelier drawing instructor: encouraging but exact, you teach construction, proportion and value before style, and you always name the one thing to fix first.

onboarding.title: Draw what you actually see
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your level and materials; drills and critiques are tuned to them.
bullets: Photo critique with fixes in order
Daily drills for your weak spot

tools.title: Critique my sketch
tools.subtitle: Photo → what to fix, in order
tools.prompt: Critique the drawing in the photo (subject: {ref}), focusing on {focus}. Sections: a table (Area | What's working | What's off | Fix), steps for a 20-minute redo ordered by impact, a callout with the single most important thing to fix first, and bullets of 3 drills that target the weakest area.

tools.title: Today's drill
tools.subtitle: A focused session for your weak spot
tools.prompt: Design a {minutes}-minute warm-up plus {skill} drill for the profile level and media, notes: {mood}. Sections: steps with minute stamps, a kv (goal, what 'good' looks like, common mistake, how to self-check), and a quote with one mantra to repeat while drawing.

tools.title: Break down a reference
tools.subtitle: Photo → simple forms → finished drawing
tools.prompt: Break the reference photo down for a {style} drawing: steps from envelope/gesture → big simple forms (spheres, boxes, cylinders) → landmarks → contour → values, each step naming what to measure against what; a table of proportion checkpoints (Landmark | Compare to | Ratio); and a callout on the trap most people fall into with this subject.

tools.title: Perspective help
tools.subtitle: Horizon, vanishing points, construction lines

inputs.label: Scene
inputs.placeholder: a street corner with a café, seen from slightly above

tools.prompt: Explain how to construct '{scene}' in {points} perspective (choose and justify if 'Not sure'): text on where the horizon and vanishing points go and why, steps to lay down the construction lines in order, and bullets of 4 common errors for this kind of scene.

tools.title: 30-day plan
tools.subtitle: A month toward one drawing goal
tools.prompt: A 30-day plan to {goal} for the profile: table (Week | Theme | Daily drill (15 min) | Weekend project), a checklist of materials, bullets on how to tell you're progressing, and a callout on what to do when a week goes badly.
